organization.name_ja: チューリッヒ保険会社

affected.note: Up to 757,463 past and current Super Auto Insurance policyholders. Data included surname only, gender, date of birth, email address, policy number, customer ID and vehicle and policy details. Credit card and bank account data were not included.

summary.en: Zurich Insurance's Japan branch said on 2023-01-10 that customer data had been posted on an overseas site after an outside contractor suffered unauthorized access. Data of up to 757,463 Super Auto Insurance policyholders, including surnames, birthdates and email addresses, was leaked.
summary.ja: チューリッヒ保険会社は2023年1月10日、外部委託業者が第三者からの不正アクセスを受け、顧客の個人情報が海外のサイトに掲載されたと公表した。「スーパー自動車保険」の契約者最大757,463人分の姓、生年月日、メールアドレスなどが漏えいした。
